script.problem: The one line is more than one sentence.
It copies the given entry: "david fled from saul to achish king of gath". Write it in your own words.

terra.problem: “David pretends to be mad” says Achish sent David away, but 1 Samuel 21:10-15 does not say that. The following verse says David left Gath.

The title “Giants fall at Gath” suggests that multiple giants were killed there. The cited passage describes one such death in a battle at Gath; it does not say all four descendants of Rapha were killed there.
